# Name: # Multi-app partition table for the on-device launcher.
# 6 app slots of 2 MiB each (aligned to the 64 KB boundary app partitions
# require): "launcher" always boots first on a fresh chip (blank otadata
# defaults to ota_0); slot1..slot5 hold whatever apps flash.sh has assigned
# them to (see APP_SLOTS in flash.sh and the manifest in
# src/apps/launcher/manifest.h -- both must agree
# Slots were originally 960 KB each
Type: sized against apps with no networking.

# Name: # Adding Wi-Fi to one app (the TCP/IP stack + WebServer) pushed its binary
# past that on the first build that actually included it -- 1.07 MB
# ~630 KB like every prior app. Bumped to 2 MiB per slot rather than give
# just that one app special-cased sizing: flash is abundant (16 MB total)
# and every app benefits from the same headroom for whatever it grows into.
# Switching apps at runtime calls esp_ota_set_boot_partition() on one of
# these six and reboots; nothing here is touched by that
# the app images physically live. ~3.9 MB of the 16 MB chip is still left
# unpartitioned for further growth.
nvs
otadata
launcher
slot1
slot2
slot3
